text:
Maya: Quick ask — we need a region-by-region placement plan for inference clusters next quarter. Can someone pull a cost + capacity delta for US (us-west-2/us-east-1), EU (eu-west-1), and APAC (ap-southeast-1)? Thinking reserved/commit vs spot mix, plus egress/replication costs.

Rahul: I can pull billing numbers and current utilization. Heads up: APAC has fewer H100 pools available and higher per-hour list price.

billing-bot: Export link: https://billing.example.com/exports/2026-q2-geo-breakdown.csv (s3://redwood-billing/exports/2026-q2-geo-breakdown.csv)

Lucas: From infra side: latency-sensitive models need <60ms p99 to our EU customers, so EU placement may be required for some tenants. For non-latency workloads we can centralize in US to get better reserved pricing.

Sophie: Also factor in data residency constraints — two customers require EU-only. That reduces our effective commitable pool in EU.

Maya: TL;DR we need: (1) per-GPU effective $/hr after discounts per region, (2) egress impact for cross-region routing, (3) a suggested commit sizing for 3/12 month plans.

Rahul: Quick numbers (raw from billing, rounded):
```
- us-west-2: H100 list $12.0/hr, reserved 1yr 35% -> $7.8/hr
- us-east-1: A100 80GB list $7.5/hr, reserved 1yr 30% -> $5.25/hr
- eu-west-1: H100 list $13.5/hr, reserved 1yr 30% -> $9.45/hr
- ap-southeast-1: H100 list $14.8/hr, reserved 1yr 25% -> $11.1/hr
```
Numbers exclude egress & storage. Spot average discounts: ~65-75% on A100, 50-60% on H100 (varies).

Lucas: Important: provisioning lead time in EU for H100 is ~3-4 weeks right now. If we commit, we need to place orders early.

Maya: Good. What's typical commit utilization for Dedicated clusters today?

billing-bot: Current commit utilization: us-west-2 82%, us-east-1 67%, eu-west-1 54%, ap-southeast-1 38%.

Sophie: EU low utilization is partly because we keep capacity cold for contracts but haven't put cross-tenant pooling in place. We could permit safe tenant co-location to raise from 54% -> ~75%. Needs legal signoff for tenant mixing.

Rahul: Egress example: serving EU users from US adds ~$0.09/GB egress + adds ~50ms median latency. Our typical text gen is 40KB per session -> $0.0036/session egress but latency penalty. For high-throughput embedding workloads egress adds up.

Lucas: Proposal: commit baseline in US (60% of commit budget), commit a smaller pool in EU sized to guaranteed EU-only customers (30%), keep APAC mostly spot + burst pool (10%) with a regional cache/proxy to reduce egress.

Maya: Sketch cost calc for a 100-GPU effective commit budget:
```
Option A (centralized US heavy):
- 60 H100-equivalent in us-west-2 @ $7.8/hr -> $468/hr
- 30 A100-equivalent in eu @ $9.45/hr -> $283.5/hr
- 10 spots in apac variable
Option B (geo-distributed):
- 40 us @ $7.8/hr -> $312/hr
- 40 eu @ $9.45/hr -> $378/hr
- 20 apac mixed reserved/spot -> ~$220-260/hr
```
Numbers illustrative. Need normalized GPU-equivalent mapping for cost parity (H100 vs A100 perf).

Sophie: Also consider network topology: cross-region KV cache misses cause extra API calls. We should run a small experiment: colocate prefix cache for EU with a 10-GPU test cluster and measure hit rate.

Lucas: Agreed. I can spin a 10-GPU EU test cluster on reserved bunch with canary traffic. Command we use: `deploy cluster --region eu-west-1 --sku h100 --count 10 --env canary`

Rahul: For commitment term: 12-month seems safer — 3-year gives deeper discounts but kills flexibility. If new models require H200-ish changes next year, we're stuck. Recommend 12m with quarterly re-eval.

Maya: Action items: (1) Rahul: produce a normalized $/perf/hr spreadsheet mapping A100->H100 perf for our common models + per-region effective costs (due EOD Fri). (2) Lucas: start EU 10-GPU canary and measure cache hit/latency (start tomorrow). (3) Sophie: legal run on tenant co-location rules (help with gating). (4) Finance: can we get a 60% up-front commit payment quote for EU? (tagging @finance)

Lucas: small note — watch out for regional egress tiers. If we route cross-region persistent KV replication it'll blow costs; prefer async replication for non-critical caches.

billing-bot: I exported a draft normalized sheet: https://billing.example.com/drafts/geo-normalized-2026-03-18.csv

Maya: thanks. Let's keep this thread as the single source for placement decision notes. Ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Deploy job queued: job_id=deploy-1802501288 for `deploy cluster --region eu-west-1 --sku h100 --count 10 --env canary`. ETA: 26m.

Rahul: Will follow up with the spreadsheet. If EU utilization can be pushed to 75% via safe co-location, the marginal cost per effective GPU drops ~20% — that changes commit sizing decision.

Sophie: Noted. Looping in legal tomorrow.

Maya: Great. Last question — any red flags on network peering or interconnect quotas per region?

Lucas: We have soft limits on inter-region egress for ap-southeast-1; raising quota takes ~2 business days. For heavy replication we might need direct connect partners in APAC; that's a procurement thing.

Maya: Perfect. Thanks all.
